column1: # Deliberate copies of Z9X files in the Play 6 port, checked by
# tools/play6/check_forks.py (check F). One row per copy, tab-separated, paths relative to gsi/:
#   play6 path <TAB> Z9X origin <TAB> sha256 of the origin at fork time <TAB> note
# A row is added when the copy is made. When F reports that an origin changed: review the Z9X change,
# port what applies to the Play 6 copy, then write the origin's new sha256 here (this file only).
# Synced copies (apps/common/sync.sh) are not forks and are not listed.
